messages:
Maria: FYI, scheduled cutover tonight 23:00 UTC. Runtime -> v2.5.0, API -> v1.13.0, Router -> v3.1.0. Console will be pinned to the schema version for safety. Call out blockers now.

Deploy Bot: deployment scheduled by Maria for 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z. Plan: canary 5% -> 30m observe -> 25% -> final ramp. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-cutover

Raj: Ack. Running client compatibility tests now. Quick question: confirm console schema pin version? @Maria

Maria: Pin to schema v202602 for the window. We saw a field-ordering flake last week when console was unpinned.

Oliver: Runtime note: v2.5.0 flips on KV-cache prefix eviction heuristics. Shouldn't break KV API but expect longer warm-up for cold keys. Monitor runtime.kv.cache.hit_rate and p99 gen latency.

Sophie: Drafted internal release blurb: "KV eviction heuristics; router TTL bugfix; API minor param rename (backwards compatible)." Will add external release notes tomorrow.

DevEx: Heads-up: SDKs <0.8.4 will emit a harmless warning for the renamed param. I'll drop a short snippet in #docs to smooth upgrades.

Yuki: Rollback triggers: if canary 5xx > 0.8% OR p99 latency +25% sustained for 10m -> rollback runtime+router to previous pinned versions. API can be rolled back independently if we trace errors to it.

Maria: Add data-safety gate: no audit-log schema changes. Console pin prevents that. If partners report missing route metadata, mark sev-2 and pause ramp.

Ops Bot: preflight complete in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. GPU pools healthy. Available capacity slots: 12.

Raj: Client e2e + smoke passed on staging v1.13.0. Embeddings and typical prompt flows look good.

Oliver: Canary-only runtime flags to apply (ops runbook):
```
runtime.flags:\n  enable_kv_eviction: true\n  eviction_threshold: 0.85\n  batch_window_ms: 8\n```
Applying only on canary nodes.

Maria: Ops/Oncall: monitor error-rate, token-cost anomalies, and cache-hit. Platform: hold non-critical changes in this change-window for 4 hours.

Sophie: I'll post the internal announce right before canary and ping partners when canary looks stable.

Deploy Bot: deployment 1719001234 started: canary (5%) now routing.

Ops Bot: new canary baseline created. Dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/kv-cache/kv-ops?orgId=1

Raj: Initial 3m p99 +4% (expected warm-up). Cache-hit moving 12% -> 41% over ~7m.

Yuki: Keep an eye on error spikes. If API 5xx > 0.5% escalate immediately.

Deploy Bot: canary health check OK. Proceeding to 25% after 30m observation window.

Maria: Proceed if no alerts. Speak up now if you object.

Oliver: No objections. Rolling to 25%.

Ops Bot: traffic shifted to 25% at 2026-03-20T23:37:00Z.

Raj: All canary endpoints passed payload correctness and schema checks. No diffs in responses.

DevEx: Posted migration snippet: `client.updateParams({compat: true})` and note about the param rename in #docs.

Yuki: Watch third-party integrators for router path normalization issues during 25% ramp. They sometimes trigger edge-case routing.

Deploy Bot: deployment 1719001234 final: rollout complete, 100% traffic.

Maria: Nice work. Follow-ups: (1) add postmortem checklist item for kv-eviction metric drift, (2) publish external release notes tomorrow, (3) schedule short cross-team sync if partners report anomalies.

Sophie: Will publish external notes tomorrow AM and create postmortem template if drift shows up.

Raj: Closing my checklist; will monitor for two more hours.

Yuki: Standing by for rollback triggers but system stable. :thumbsup:

Maria: Closing thread. If anything appears, reopen or start a new thread with the deploy id.
